title: 03-08 Corolla Lower Dash Switch Plate
author: Maple
description:
This plate replaces the stock lower dash storage door that comes in the 03-08 Toyota Corollas

It has slots for 3 switches on the left hand side, closest to the driver. 1 slot for a switch or a usb interface on the passenger side.

Its made to screw into the sides of the storage bin with 2 screws or rivets.

You can also mix and match by mirroring the parts in the Bambu app on windows along the x axis. Made on the A1 Mini, will possibly make a version for other printers if requested.

toyota corolla switch plate cover car accessories
